newsitem.title: UK: Triplex says extends offer for Wm Cook.
newsitem.headline: Triplex says extends offer for Wm Cook.

text.p: British engineering group Triplex Lloyd Plc said on Tuesday that it was extending its cash and share offer for metal casting specialist William Cook until 1500 GMT on February 4, 1997.
Triplex, which has made a hostile bid for Cook, said it had received valid acceptances in respect of 73,883 shares representing 0.39 percent of the issued ordinary share capital of William Cook.
Triplex's bid, based on seven of its own shares and 1350 pence in cash for every nine William Cook shares, has been worth a fairly steady 309 pence since its launch in the middle of November.
The bid valued William Cook at just under 58 million stg, which the target firm claimed was lower than its true value.
City analysts expect Triplex to raise the bid to about 400 pence per share.
William Cook's share price rose three pence to 358 on Tuesday with Triplex Lloyd remaining firm at 204 pence.
